Automated behaviors ("from now on when X", "each time X", "whenever X", "before/after X") require hooks configured in settings.json - the harness executes these, not Claude, so memory/preferences cannot fulfill them. Also use for: permissions ("allow X", "add permission", "move permission to"), env vars ("set X=Y"), hook troubleshooting, or any changes to settings.json/settings.local.json files. Separately, no "database-cleanup" job name exists anywhere in the codebase.

r03. Premise correction: there is no nightly database-cleanup job scheduled in this repository. The only cron-style schedules present are illustrative examples in `internal/scheduler/example_test.go` (e.g., `"0 2 * * *"` for a job literally named `"cleanup"` in `ExampleMultipleJobs`, `internal/scheduler/example_test.go:100`), but this scheduler package isn't wired up anywhere in the actual server (`server/`) — no file imports `internal/scheduler` outside its own test files — so no real database-cleanup job is registered or scheduled to run.
